prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a luminous porcelain-fair complexion with a cool-pink undertone, early 20s goddess, hourglass SSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size; below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, projecting forward past the line of her own knees, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds; enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms; her head looks small on top of her massive body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, top bun honey blonde hair — wearing a skin-tight micro school blazer set, a cropped sleeveless blazer-style top of ultra-thin matte navy scuba crepe with gold-trimmed lapels, a small gold crest patch on the left of her chest and a slim navy-and-gold striped tie at her throat, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to the cropped hem and the two sides of the scuba crepe fully covering her bust, ending right under her bust with her whole midriff and stomach bare, and an ultra-micro cargo mini skirt of ultra-thin matte light-grey scuba crepe with two small flap pockets on the front and a thin utility belt with a metal buckle at the waist, sitting at the top of her hip bones with the hem ending just below her hip bones, a side slit up to the hip bone. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small mole near her collarbone and very fine pale hair on her forearms catching the light. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin scuba crepe molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the gold-trimmed lapels, the small gold crest and the striped tie crisp against the navy, the clean edges of the cargo pockets and utility belt, a smooth pebbled crepe texture and fine stretch lines. Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on the outer hip, the other raised overhead, her legs fully in view — most extreme hourglass SSBBW silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of glossy navy leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, ballerina nails each as long as her whole hand, in navy lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large statement drop earrings of blackened iron and polished gold as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Japanese woman (East Asian Japanese features: a soft rounded short face with full cheeks and a small delicate chin, small narrow monolid eyes set slightly wide apart with no crease, a low soft nose bridge with a rounded tip, small modest lips, soft low flat eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: large round eyes with bright real catchlights, thick curled lashes with drawn-on lower lashes, soft pink and lilac eyeshadow, round pink blush, glossy cherry-pink lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows light natural skin glow, subtle healthy sheen.

Background: a sunlit red-rock canyon floor with a smooth sandy path, low boulders of knee height and a waist-high wooden trail rail, just after the rain, with wet surfaces shining softly, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
